Based on our own route calculations using Google Maps, the actual extra distance was very minimal and nowhere close to what they were claiming.Even after sharing screenshots and complete route details of all places covered during the trip, the company showed no interest in verifying anything fairly. They simply kept insisting on charging hundreds of extra kilometers without proper justification.The most disturbing part happened during our return to Delhi. We started receiving continuous calls from another operator demanding immediate payment of the extra amount. When we questioned the unfair charges, the driver stopped the vehicle on the roadside and refused to continue the journey for almost 1.5 hours.Travelling with family and luggage while worrying about missing our train made the entire situation extremely stressful. When we contacted the company, we were clearly told that the vehicle would only continue after payment was made. Since we had no alternative and were under pressure, we were forced to pay the demanded amount just to complete the trip safely and on time.This was a completely unprofessional experience filled with hidden charges, poor communication, and pressure tactics. Rather than creating good memories, the trip became mentally exhausting because of constant disputes over money.Would never recommend this company to others unless every single condition regarding sightseeing, extra kilometers, and additional charges is clearly documented before the trip starts. Very disappointing experience overall.
